examples.en: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
The adventurers climbed the peak of the mountain with difficulty.
Indeed, God is beautiful and loves beauty.
So beautiful patience [is fitting], and God is the one sought for help.

examples.ar: بَذَلَ العُلَمَاءُ جُهْدًا عَالِيًا فِي مَعْمَلِ الأَبْحَاثِ.
examples.en: The scientists made a high effort in the research laboratory.

examples.ar: الرِّيَاضَةُ تُغَذِّي الجَسَدَ وَتَمْنَحُهُ حَيَوِيَّةً كَبِيرَةً.
examples.en: Sports nourish the body and grant it great vitality.

examples.ar: يَدْرُسُ أَخِي الهَنْدَسَةَ فِي جَامِعَةِ بَغْدَادَ العَرِيقَةِ.
examples.en: My brother studies engineering at the ancient University of Baghdad.

examples.ar: تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا.
examples.en: Rivers flowing beneath them, wherein they abide eternally.

examples.ar: العِلْمُ يَبْنِي بُيُوتًا لَا عِمَادَ لَهَا .. وَالجَهْلُ يَهْدِمُ بَيْتَ العِزِّ وَالشَّرَفِ.
examples.en: Knowledge builds houses that have no pillars, while ignorance destroys the house of glory and honor.

examples.ar: تَنْتَقِلُ التَّقَالِيدُ مِنْ جِيلٍ إِلَى آخَرَ بِفَخْرٍ.
examples.en: Traditions are passed from one generation to another with pride.
